changes: Stronger Gemini 3.1 Pro model for both methods.
Typed nullable fields, per-document supporting quotes, explicit partial/stale/cancelled records and allocation rows.
Batch newly observed documents; deduplicate equivalent reader costs by unique provider receipt.
Common interpreter refuses missing quantities/status/years instead of treating partial records as answers.
unchanged: Exact V2 case IDs, raw evidence, private oracle, source tools/prices, limits and repetition count.
Fixed source-routing policy, grader and planner prompt.
semanticControl: Both arms receive identical per-document extractions only after observing that document. New documents may be read in a batch. Each arm is costed once per unique reader receipt, including shared reuse. Cache keys include model and prompt version. Hidden records never enter the cache until queried.
decision: Do not claim agent benefit unless quality and useful coverage match the fixed-reader arm and equivalent machine cost falls. Human time and production PayPal benefit remain unmeasured.
limitations: Ten known development cases; no independent validation or holdout claim.
Two trials per case are a pilot, not a reliability estimate.
Reader fixes were motivated by the earlier observed development failures; improvement is not independent generalization.
The reader and model changed together; cross-version improvement cannot be assigned to either alone.
Fixed normalized reference uses authored extraction and is not an end-to-end competitor.
Physical wall times are not fair latency comparisons because the second arm reuses reader outputs.
